scope: Read-only source review and CPU-only focused controls. No runtime, model, scene, service or rule changes by reviewer.
checks: Re-approach uses the original fixed entry, owner, original normal program and crossing request timestamp; no endpoint retarget.
Recovery is allowed only within 1.0m XY / 0.15m Z of that entry, outside roadway and painted crossing. This bound defines safe recovery eligibility, not arrival.
An actual native full-path proof and a real accepted nonnegative native task ID are required; repeated polls reuse the task instead of issuing new commands.
Both immutable selected endpoints are rechecked for current body clearance before Runtime asks for recovery; occupancy stays pending without a new task.

A bounded curb request retains its next-cohort reservation during recovery, so normal-first walkers may wait. Owned crossing is separately refused until the actor is in waiting phase at the actual original 0.35m entry tolerance, with verified arrival.
Existing WALK, native path, shared cohort, actor/session/epoch, restoration and whole-body exit guards remain.
Pending recovery cannot reset the Director's original latched signal-wait budget or overall finite deadline.
Rejected or failed native commands, clock rollback, generation/epoch change and explicit cancellation fail closed and restore the original program.

independentTests.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/people -p test_owned_cohort.py -q

remainingLimit: CPU controls establish the source contract. Successful dynamic avoidance, timely same-entry recovery and complete native/AI episode still require the parent's bounded live retry; no live-pass claim is made here.
